title: Folk Rock
tagline: Traditional songcraft and acoustic storytelling with a rock band's electricity.
summary: Folk rock combines folk songwriting and acoustic traditions with electric instruments and rock arrangements. The style became prominent in the 1960s, when artists adapted folk material and wrote new songs for amplified bands. It continues to connect narrative lyrics and roots influences with the energy and reach of rock music.

pillars.name: Bob Dylan
pillars.why: Dylan's move to electric arrangements became a prominent moment in folk rock's development.

pillars.name: The Byrds
pillars.why: The Byrds connected folk material and close harmonies with jangling electric guitars.

pillars.name: Fairport Convention
pillars.why: Fairport Convention developed a British folk-rock sound that brought traditional songs into electric arrangements.
